critical_code_review_comments: consulting.py is well-structured but 646 lines; still under the 700-line guideline. If more features are added (audio transcription, additional export formats), consider splitting into consulting/router.py + consulting/pdf.py + consulting/prompts.py.

In case_chat generate(), if the client disconnects mid-stream the assistant message is NOT persisted (documented as expected). Consider awaiting a final save even on CancelledError so partial answers are preserved — currently exceptions during streaming yield an inline [ERROR] but nothing is stored (any chunks already sent are lost).

generate_final_report loads all messages into memory and re-sends them as initial_messages plus a large prompt; for very long cases this may blow the model's context window. Consider truncating or summarising older turns.

list_case_documents uses DOC_BLOCK_RE.findall which returns tuples; loop uses (title, body) correctly, but preview strips markdown chars naively (may remove legitimate hyphens in dates like 12-03-2025). Cosmetic only.

In _prepare_attachment_contents, pandas.read_excel is imported lazily but the whole file is loaded synchronously in a request thread; large XLSX would block the event loop. Consider running in a thread executor.
